description.p: Termoak is a native SSH client (no web views) with the same sessions, hosts and keys on your computer and on your phone.
Termoak es un cliente SSH nativo (sin webviews) con las mismas sesiones, servidores y claves en tu ordenador y en tu móvil.
Sessions that never drop: open the terminal on the Termoak server and pick it up where you left it, from this computer or from another device, with its history and its processes.
Sesiones que no se cortan: abre la terminal en el servidor de Termoak y sigue donde la dejaste, desde este ordenador o desde otro dispositivo, con su historial y sus procesos.

ul.li: SSH with passwords, keys (Ed25519, RSA, ECDSA) and reusable identities; jump hosts, proxy, agent forwarding and keep-alive
SSH con contraseña, claves (Ed25519, RSA, ECDSA) e identidades reutilizables; jump hosts, proxy, agent forwarding y keep-alive
Tabs and split view with up to 16 terminals, and broadcast typing to all of them
Pestañas y vista dividida con hasta 16 terminales, y escritura simultánea en todas
SFTP browser with a transfer queue, drag and drop, and editing remote files on this computer
Explorador SFTP con cola de transferencias, arrastrar y soltar, y edición de archivos remotos en este ordenador
Local terminal, Telnet and serial port
Terminal local, Telnet y puerto serie
Snippets to run commands on one or many servers at once, and port forwarding
Snippets para lanzar comandos en uno o varios servidores a la vez, y reenvío de puertos
Import from ~/.ssh/config, PuTTY, MobaXterm, SecureCRT, Termius, ZOC and CSV
Importación desde ~/.ssh/config, PuTTY, MobaXterm, SecureCRT, Termius, ZOC y CSV

description.p: Encrypted, synced vault: hosts, keys, identities and snippets encrypted and synced across all your devices. Organize them in vaults: a personal one, others shared with people or your team, with Editor or Use-only permissions (connect without seeing passwords).

Bóveda cifrada y sincronizada: servidores, claves, identidades y snippets cifrados y sincronizados entre todos tus dispositivos. Organízalos en vaults: uno personal, otros compartidos con personas o con tu equipo, con permisos de Editor o Solo uso (conectar sin ver contraseñas).
Share your terminal: invite a person, your team or create a link. By default they can only watch; they can ask for the keyboard and you decide when to give it and for how long.
Comparte tu terminal: invita a una persona, a tu equipo o crea un enlace. Por defecto solo pueden mirar; pueden pedirte el teclado y tú decides cuándo darlo y durante cuánto tiempo.

AI in the terminal and in the background: explain or fix a failed command, or ask the AI to investigate a failure or prepare a deployment. It asks for your approval before running anything sensitive and works with your own API keys.

IA en la terminal y en segundo plano: explica o corrige un comando que ha fallado, o pide a la IA que investigue un fallo o prepare un despliegue. Te pide permiso antes de ejecutar algo delicado y funciona con tus propias claves de API.

Use the official server termoak.com or your own Termoak server, even several at once. Two-step verification, encrypted secrets and open source (AGPL-3.0), so you can audit it or run your own server. Free, no ads, no card required.

Usa el servidor oficial termoak.com o tu propio servidor de Termoak, incluso varios a la vez. Verificación en dos pasos, secretos cifrados y código abierto (AGPL-3.0) para que puedas auditarlo o instalar tu propio servidor. Gratis, sin anuncios y sin tarjeta.

ul.li: AI in the terminal: explain and fix failed commands, AI tasks with approvals that show what will run, multi-host tasks and redaction of secrets
Telnet hosts and host logos
Import and export: Termoak JSON, CSV, ssh config, Termius, PuTTY, MobaXterm, SecureCRT and ZOC
SFTP transfer queue, drag and drop, and files dropped on a terminal are uploaded
Command palette, find in the terminal, workspaces, host status, app lock and notifications when a long command ends
Several accounts and vaults: personal, shared with people or with your team, with Editor or Use-only permissions
Live session sharing: participants, one driver at a time, waiting room and join by link
Desktop notifications, File → New window and smaller binaries
